title: USERAUTH_REQUEST after USERAUTH_SUCCESS is not silently ignored
quote: Any non-authentication messages sent by the client after the request that resulted in SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_SUCCESS being sent MUST be passed to the service being run, and any authentication request messages sent after that SHOULD be silently ignored.
rationale: After SR_AUTH and a successful authentication, a second UA_PW_OK gets any answer or ends the connection (v1 D4: OpenSSH UNIMPLEMENTED, Go closes; Dropbear ignores). Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D4 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
